_comment: Authored fields only, matching Hermes cron/jobs.py JOB_DEFINITION_FIELDS. Do not copy this into ~/.hermes/cron/jobs.json by hand: that file is owned by the scheduler (ids, next_run_at, state). Create the job with `hermes cron create` or by accepting the skill blueprint via /suggestions. See the README.
name: Daily job scout
prompt: Run the daily job-scout scan. Follow the job-scout skill exactly. If script output is already in context, use it and do not fetch job sites yourself. If the first line is NO_NEW_MATCHES, respond with only [SILENT]. Otherwise send a short digest: title, company, location, one-line reason, and URL for each match. After sending, run the script again with --update-seen. Do not invent details that are not in the script output.
schedule_display: Every day at 8:00 AM local time
